All objectives are complete and verified. Final report:

**Objective 1 — DONE.** The provisioned dashboard `Service health` (at `/d/bench-service-health/service-health`, breadcrumb "Home / Dashboards / Bench / Service Health") has exactly three panels, in on-screen order:
1. `Request rate`
2. `Error count`
3. `Latency by endpoint`

**Objective 2 — DONE.** A new dashboard titled `fwgr37-n1 Bench Dashboard` was created and saved (green "Dashboard saved" status alert observed). It contains a **Stat** panel titled `fwgr37-n1 Availability`. Verified in the panel editor: the visualization picker reads exactly "Stat", and the query's data source picker shows **TestData** (icon alt "TestData logo", placeholder "TestData", dropdown current selection "(TestData)"), with the default Random Walk scenario. The panel renders a live stat value (observed 19.3 / 63.3 / 73.8 / 9.93 across loads).

**Objective 3 — DONE.** The dashboard also contains a **Text** panel titled `fwgr37-n1 Notes` whose rendered content is: "Notes for run fwgr37-n1: benchmark dashboard created via automation." — confirmed to contain the runid. Saved with a "Dashboard saved" confirmation.

**Objective 4 — DONE.** The dashboard has the tag `bench` (verified in Settings → General → Tags, which shows a single "bench" chip; re-opened after save and still present). The time range is set to **Last 6 hours** and persisted into the saved dashboard: I ticked the save dialog's "Update default time range" checkbox before saving (Save was disabled with "No changes to save" until it was ticked, then showed "Changes 1"). Persistence proof: loading the bare dashboard URL with no query params redirects to `?from=now-6h&to=now` and the top bar reads "Last 6 hours".

**Objective 5 — DONE.** The auto-refresh interval is **1m** and persisted: I selected "1 minute" in the top-bar refresh picker, then ticked the save dialog's "Update default refresh value — Will make the current refresh the new default" checkbox and saved ("Dashboard saved" alert). Persistence proof: a fresh reload of the dashboard URL with no query params shows the refresh picker as "1m" (accessible name "…current interval 1 minute selected").

**Objective 6 — DONE.** URL read from the browser's address bar on a fresh load of the dashboard:
`http://127.0.0.1:3000/d/efyb929ghje9sf/fwgr37-n1-bench-dashboard?from=now-6h&to=now&timezone=browser`
Dashboard UID: `efyb929ghje9sf` (slug `fwgr37-n1-bench-dashboard`).

Final state re-verified end-to-end on a fresh search-based load: dashboard title `fwgr37-n1 Bench Dashboard`, two panels (`fwgr37-n1 Notes`, `fwgr37-n1 Availability`), time range "Last 6 hours", refresh "1m", tag `bench`. No objective failed.
